# Nature to Nurture Nutrition & Recovery

> Personalised nutrition and recovery support from Samantha, a qualified Living Nutrition Practitioner based in Webheath, Redditch (UK). Consultations are held online by video.

Samantha holds a Diploma in Living Nutrition (DLN) from the College of Living Nutrition and is a registered member of The Complementary Medical Association (MCMA). She has over fifteen years in the wellness industry and supports people of all ages, with a particular interest in children's nutrition and nutrition before, during and after pregnancy. Her approach is to find the root cause, then support it with living nutrition and herbal supplements.

## Services and prices

- 15-minute introduction consultation (online): £20. Recommended first step.
- Personalised consultation (online): £70
- Consultation for a child under 18 (online): £60
- Follow-up consultation (online): £40
- Food intolerance and gut health testing: only through practitioner-only partners, as a package with a consultation where Samantha talks you through the results. Ask for options and prices.
- Testing partners: GutMapDx and Cambridge Nutritional Sciences (FoodPrint food intolerance tests). Their tests are not sold direct to the public.
- GutMapDx specialises in personalised nutrition for gut health. Tests are done at home and analysed by partner laboratories under strict quality control; results are checked against a database of more than 150,000 samples and over 150 published studies, giving clear reports and a personal nutrition plan.
- Supplements and body care: coming soon.
